note: Alberta Parks campground on the northwest shore of Lesser Slave Lake near Grouard: five treed loops a short walk through the forest from the shore, with a shower building. The beach, boat launch and day-use area are about 1 km east; the dump station is at the park entrance, 3.4 km west. Accessible sites D-130 and E-150. --Claude
